info.name: HESCO Backend - hesco-backend-clean-architecture
info.description: End-to-end runnable collection against the hesco-modernization backend (branch: hesco-backend-clean-architecture). Requests are ordered so running the collection top-to-bottom (Runner or Ctrl+Alt+Enter) builds a realistic Circle -> Division -> Sub-Division -> Feeder -> Work Order -> Survey Form -> full 4-tier approval chain, with each request's response IDs captured into collection variables and fed into the next request. Assumes the DB has only the Flyway seed data (roles, equipment types, item categories) - i.e. a fresh hesco_local. Role IDs referenced in test scripts match V1 seed order: 1=HESCO_ADMIN 2=GIS_ADMIN 3=APPROVER_2 4=APPROVER_1 5=CREATOR 6=SURVEYOR 7=PLANNING_ENGINEER_AREA 8=PLANNING_ENGINEER_LINELOSS 9=DASHBOARD_USER.

7. Negative / Validation Examples
item.description: Every request here is EXPECTED to fail with a 4xx - each one exercises a specific app-layer validator (AdminBoundCodeValidator, UserRoleBoundValidator, EquipmentSequenceValidator, WorkOrderStateMachineService) directly, proving the business rule lives in Java, not the DB. Run these AFTER folder 6, since several reuse ids captured there.

item.name: [Expect 400] Division code doesn't match parent Circle prefix

request.description: AdminBoundCodeValidator.validateDivisionCode should reject this: code '9999' does not start with the parent circle's code (110).
@Pattern(regexp = "\\d{3}") on CircleRequest.code should reject this at the DTO level.
UserRoleBoundValidator should reject this: role SURVEYOR has requiresImei=true and no imei field was supplied (SRS §3.2.3/§8.1.1).

item.name: [Expect 400] HESCO Admin created WITH a bound assignment

request.description: UserRoleBoundValidator should reject this: HESCO_ADMIN's assignedBoundType is SYSTEM_WIDE, which must have no circle/division/sub-division set.

exec: pm.test("Rejected - system-wide role cannot have a bound", () =>

item.name: [Expect 400] Approver 1 tries to REJECT without a comment

request.description: WorkOrderStateMachineService should reject this: the SUBMITTED->REJECT transition has requiresComment=true (SRS §3.6.4.1 'mandatory comment'). NOTE: only run this against a work order still in SUBMITTED status - the happy-path chain above will already have moved {{workOrderId}} past SUBMITTED, so point this at a fresh work order in SUBMITTED status if reusing the same environment.

item.name: [Expect 400] Surveyor tries to APPROVE a work order (wrong role for transition)

request.description: WorkOrderStateMachineService.applyTransition looks up (fromStatus, action, role) - there is no SURVEYOR row for the APPROVE action, so this must fail regardless of the work order's current status.

exec: pm.test("Rejected - no legal transition for this role/action pair", () =>

item.name: 8. Reports Service (Feeder Assets Reports, SRS §3.15)
item.description: GET-only reporting endpoints under /api/reports. Every endpoint requires at least one of circleId/divisionId/subDivisionId/feederId - omitting all four returns 400 (MissingReportScopeException). dateFrom/dateTo are optional ISO-8601 OffsetDateTime filters. Run after folder 4 (Feeder) and folder 6 (Work Order Lifecycle) so {{feederId}} / {{circleId}} are populated from real survey data.

request.description: One row per pole/structure item_type in the relevant item_category, scoped to the given feeder. Fixed-column ReportCountItem shape: code, label, count.

item.name: Pole Structure Summary - by Circle + Date Range

request.description: Same report rolled up at circle level with a survey date-range filter applied.
One row per conductor item_type - segment count plus total surveyed length in meters. ReportLengthItem shape: code, label, count, totalLengthMeters.
One row per power-transformer capacity/item_type value, scoped to the given feeder. ReportCountItem shape: code, label, count.
No item_type dimension to group by - meter_detail doesn't reference item_type - so this is a flat scoped count. MeterSummaryResponse shape: { count }.

Feeder-row Device Report (SRS §3.15.2.1). One row per feeder; transformer counts are split into dedicatedTransformers[] and generalDutyTransformers[] (item_type-driven under TRANSFORMER_CAPACITY, cross-joined with EQUIPMENT_USE DEDICATED/GENERAL_DUTY), each with its own subtotal, plus a per-feeder total. Capacitor Banks are not included — no capacitor capacity (KVR) item_category exists in current seed data.

item.name: 9. Survey Forms - Equipment Type Detail Payloads
item.description: Demonstrates the four detail sub-objects on POST /api/survey-forms/sync - poleDetail (SRS §8.3.3), conductorDetail (§8.3.4, sent whenever S/E is End Point regardless of equipment type), transformerDetail (§8.3.5), and meterDetail (§8.3.6). Assumes folder 6 has already run so {{workOrderId}} and {{surveyorUserId}} are populated. Each request uses its own gpsNumberN collection variable so they don't collide with folder 6's gpsNumber1/gpsNumber2.
